node.title: F-valued word source => e-interleaved base-list witness (Pro, verified)
node.statement: Every trivial-stabilizer noncontainment non-tower horizontal component with F-valued word source is, at its generic point, an e=[E:B]-interleaved base-field multiplication-slice witness (syndrome commutes with B-basis expansion since D subset B; mult-by-z = M_z; noncontainment preserved). The ordinary-base-list version is FALSE (proved extension-line counterexample).
